versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file from the project.
- No changes to functionality or documentation within SKILL.md or core logic.

Initial release — stream-extracts large archives chunk by chunk, deleting processed parts to save disk space.

- Supports single and multi-volume ZIP, RAR, TAR, and TAR.GZ archives.
- Removes consumed parts or volumes during extraction, minimizing free space required.
- Includes CLI scripts and a GUI; covers chunk size math and script selection.
- Critical warning: source archive is destroyed after or during extraction.
- Handles password-protected archives and multi-volume sets; preserves folder structure, does not flatten files.
